headline: AI Capex Projected to Hit $1.6 Trillion Next Year
detail: This massive capital expenditure forecast for AI directly benefits your concentrated tech and chip portfolio. It suggests sustained, strong demand for the products and services your holdings provide.
rec: Consider adding to chip exposure. TSM is a strong candidate; scanner entry 420.84-420.37, stop 418.74.

headline: Tencent Beats Revenue Estimates on AI-Driven Ads
detail: Tencent's strong earnings, partly fueled by AI-driven advertising, indicates health in the broader tech sector and validates the commercial application of AI. This is a positive backdrop for your tech-heavy portfolio.
rec: No action. While positive for tech, Tencent is not a holding or on your scanner watchlist for a direct trade.
